questions.q: In the Collatz rule (halve if even, 3n + 1 if odd), which number follows 3?
Which of these numbers is a palindrome?
questions.explanation: 121 reads the same forwards and backwards.
101 is the smallest 3-digit number that reads the same both ways.

questions.q: Using the digits 1, 2, 3, 4 once each, what is the greatest 4-digit number?
questions.explanation: Arrange the digits from largest to smallest.
Pair the numbers: 5 pairs of 11 gives 55.

questions.q: What is the smallest 4-digit number that can be made from 3, 0, 5, 7 using each digit once?
questions.explanation: A number cannot start with 0, so start with 3, then use 0, 5, 7 in increasing order.
